results.name: Read-only cross-visit list, chosen focus, waiting history and explicit completion
Message requires selection, excludes private notes, supports edit preview download and changes no status
Multi-visit carry-forward keeps originals and records independent sources
Failed saves keep notes and retry once; another tab blocks stale progress
Double confirmation and cancellation of queued progress do not create extra events
Original navigation protects unsaved draft; source and copy progress remain independent
Explicit message context, clipboard failure, keyboard and narrow preview preserve state
Complete offline browser restart preserves waiting history and focus with no outgoing content
Closing queued progress and failed focus writes leave stored work unchanged
A copy retains source context but missing original is reported without redirecting
Recovery from the previous format migrates removed items and keeps new progress in backups
Unsaved edits to the same open visit cannot be overwritten by follow-up
Library import remaps copied-source links and reimport adds nothing
